subject: general
question:
**Direction: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Hyped
solution: The correct answer is **"Reduced."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Hyped"** means to promote or publicize something in an exaggerated way. (वस्‍तुओं की विशेषता को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर बताना) • **Example: ***The company **hyped**__ up their new product.* • **"Reduced"** means to make something smaller or less in amount or size. (मात्रा, क़ीमत, आकार आदि की दृष्टि से घटाना; छोटा करना) __ • **Example**: *The sign said ‘**Reduce**__ speed now’.* • The two words are opposite in meaning as one implies an increase while the other implies a decrease. ​Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (Dilate)** means to expand or widen, usually in reference to pupils or blood vessels. (बढ़ना या बढ़ाना, बड़ा होना या करना, फैलना या फैलाना) • **Option 2 (Upped) **means to increase or raise something. (किसी चीज़ को) • **Option 4 (Parlayed) **means to use something to your advantage or to turn something into a bigger success. (किसी चीज़ को अपने लाभ के लिए उपयोग करना या किसी चीज़ को बड़ी सफलता में बदलना) 212:Tc81, The correct answer is **"punctual."**
